name: DominoPost – Advanced Post Editor
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
DominoPost brings back the simplicity and efficiency of the traditional WordPress editor while enhancing it with powerful, modern features. If you love the straightforwardness of the traditional editor but need more tools to streamline your workflow, DominoPost is the perfect solution.

It provides a familiar interface with new productivity tools built directly into the toolbar:

  • Table of Contents (TOC): Instantly generate a dynamic, auto-updating Table of Contents based on the headings in your post. Customize the style (bullets, numbered, or collapsible) right from the sidebar.
  • User Case Fixer: Quickly change the case of your selected text. No more manual re-typing—just select your text and choose from Sentence case, UPPERCASE, lowercase, or Capitalized Case.
  • Copy Code Block: Easily create copyable code blocks. Select any text or code, click the button, and it will be wrapped in a formatted block with a one-click “Copy” button on the frontend.

Our goal is to provide a minimal-friction editing experience that feels native to WordPress but is packed with the extra power you need.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the dominopost folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Open any post or page to start using the DominoPost editor.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0 – 2025-10-02

  • Initial release.
  • Provides a streamlined interface.
  • Adds Table of Contents, Related Posts, and User Case Fixer tools to the editor toolbar.
  • Includes sidebar options for TOC and Related Posts customization.
